meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 当 oh-my-opencode 的发布管理员:拿到 patch/minor/major 或明确版本号后触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程,轮询到结束,核对 npm 版本、GitHub release 与 Discord 公告,最后汇报链接。发布期间不改代码、不做代码评审。
howto.when: 当你提到 “publish”、“release”、“deploy” 等关键词,或要求发布新版本时接管;必须给出 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号,没给会先停下来问你。

say.note: 触发 patch 发布并轮询到结束
按 minor 版本号发布

howto.what_en: Given patch/minor/major or an explicit version, Claude triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, polls to completion, checks npm versions, the release and the Discord post, then reports links. Ships only — no code fixes or reviews.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "publish", "release", "deploy" etc., or any request to ship a new version. It requires patch/minor/major or explicit semver; without one it stops and asks.

say_en.note: Triggers a patch release and polls to completion
Releases as the next minor version
